schema_flavor_evidence:
CREATE TABLE flavor_evidence (
            evidence_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            whisky_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            source TEXT NOT NULL,
            smws_code TEXT,
            original_tasting_note TEXT,
            source_pdf TEXT,
            extraction_confidence REAL,
            parser_confidence REAL,
            extraction_timestamp TEXT,
            vector_smoky REAL,
            vector_peaty REAL,
            vector_sherry REAL,
            vector_fruity REAL,
            vector_spicy REAL,
            vector_sweet REAL,
            vector_rich REAL
        , vector_maritime REAL)

provenance_classification.author: NOT USED (no column in flavor_evidence)
provenance_classification.evidence_id: NOT USED in flavor_evidence (note: editorial staging uses EDR-<sha16> but flavor_evidence has no evidence_id column)
provenance_classification.authority tier: NOT USED in flavor_evidence (no column; editorial staging has authority_tier, not propagated to flavor_evidence)
provenance_classification.confidence: OPTIONAL — flavor_evidence has extraction_confidence / parser_confidence columns (nullable, no NOT NULL constraint)
provenance_classification.source: REQUIRED — flavor_evidence.source column exists, nullable by schema but semantically required (manifest sets source='book')

policy: No corresponding column in flavor_evidence; absence does not block INSERT. Promotion requires only existing columns.
flavor_data_confidence is null on all 64 rows, but flavor_evidence.confidence columns are nullable; promotion proceeds without it.
manifest assigns source explicitly; satisfies the semantically-required source column.
manifest deduped; 0 duplicate ids; 0 already have a 'book' source row in prod (dup_risk={dup_risk})
all referenced columns (whisky_id, source, vector_*) exist in flavor_evidence
